name: Marriage Grant for the Marriage of the Daughter of War Disabled Ex-Servicemen above 50% Disability
benefit: Financial assistance of ₹21,000/- is given for the marriage of each dependent daughter of war-disabled ex-servicemen whose disability has been assessed as over 50%.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should be a war-disabled ex-serviceman with a disability assessed above 50%.
   1. The daughter should be at least 18 years old.
   1. The applicant can receive the benefit for up to two daughters only.
